account:
Today’s unusual business is the gathering arranged for six this evening in the town hall great hall. Innkeeper requested the appointment precisely at six and asked secretary to escort me. I approved a half-hour meeting described as concerning civic hospitality and community gatherings, but despite my requests I still have no committee list or detailed agenda. My ordinary council-letters appointment produced no correspondence at all.

There is also a substantial bread order associated with the gathering. Secretary reported that baker confirmed builder’s payment covered only eighty additional loaves; payment for the original hundred twenty remains unverified. I heard builder say he was ready to carry the final thirty-two loaves of his paid order. Secretary said builder referred questions about the original terms to innkeeper or freight. I have not authorized treasury money for it. Neighbour told me this afternoon that innkeeper said he, freight, and builder ordered refreshments, but neighbour does not know the occasion or whether everyone may attend.

The quantity of refreshments, precise timing, requested escort, and lack of a clear explanation make me suspect an organized occasion whose real purpose has not yet been shared with me. It could be a community celebration or some other hospitality event; I have no evidence sufficient to decide, and no grounds yet to call it wrongdoing. I asked innkeeper directly about tonight’s proposals, but did not hear an intelligible answer. I am now back in my office asking secretary for the committee details and payment findings, and intend to keep the six o’clock appointment.
